items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Johnny Morris, you remember that number he did, with Tony Pastor...

ctx.x: You were probably one of the first drummers besides Krupa to be really featured that much with a band, weren't you?
Yeah, I would say that, yes. And of course Johnny Morris, you remember that number he did, with Tony Pastor (HUMMING). I forget now, Johnny Morris, I think that was.
What kind of audience reception did you get?
